# Dice Box 1.1.4

Vendored browser distribution of `@3d-dice/dice-box` 1.1.4 from
https://registry.npmjs.org/@3d-dice/dice-box/-/dice-box-1.1.4.tgz.
WASM and JavaScript are upstream except three documented fixes in `world.onscreen.js`:
`resize()` delegates buffer sizing to Babylon, invalidates GPU caches and renders a frame,
so settled dice remain visible after resizing the bottom sheet. Zero-size hidden trays are ignored.
The Babylon engine enables `adaptToDeviceRatio` so its drawing buffer follows the screen
pixel density (including Retina), capped at 1.5× to bound full-screen GPU cost. Layout
and physics continue using CSS pixels. The scene optimizer is disabled: it otherwise
permanently removes shadows after a low-FPS sample, including startup.
Source maps and unused minified duplicates are omitted.
MIT license: `LICENSE`. Upstream models/textures: CC0, per
https://fantasticdice.games/docs/themes.

`tor-hero` and `tor-enemy` are local themes sharing the upstream default model.
Their original vector glyph atlas is generated by `scripts/dice-textures.cjs`.
Face 11 = Eye, face 12 = Gandalf rune; d6 face 6 carries a success mark.
No external runtime requests or build/install step is needed.

Local model adjustment: `default/default.json` scales d6 mesh and collider vertices
to 7/8 of their original dimensions. Other dice, UVs and face mappings are unchanged.
